Option 1 rendered as a cube (all edges 2x) is correct: source volume (2x)^3 forces height = base side = 2x, so the 'rectangular prism with square base' is a cube under the given dimensions. Option 2 cylinder (r=x, h=2x, diameter=2x) matches the excerpt. Accept figure as staged.

Schematic is pedagogically clear: focus F below surface, epicenter E directly above F, station S on surface, arc ES labeled, dashed wave fronts from F. Layout matches the item text; distances/curvature are illustrative as expected for a seismograph cutaway. Accept figure.
